manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Shows a tossed ball with zero velocity at the top but constant downward acceleration, and how mass changes force only.
manifest.description: A side‑by‑side view: left a lane with the ball, velocity and acceleration arrows, and a callout of the current values; right a velocity‑time plot with a moving marker. The readouts below report velocity, acceleration, force and the motion state.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
